Crown browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Crown Super Fuzz Published on August 30, 2009 Crown fuzz pedal Information The Crown Super Fuzz is one of several rebranded versions of the Japanese OEM fuzz circuit sold under different names in the late 1960s and early 1970s. It delivered the same aggressive, octave-enhanced fuzz tones that became a signature of early heavy rock and psychedelic music. Controls Expander (with On/Off switch): Adjusts the intensity of the fuzz effect and serves as the main power switch. Balance: Controls the overall output level. Tone switch: Two-way slide switch; Position 1 produces a mid-focused fuzz, Position 2 adds a heavier sustained tone with more low end. Push button switch: Top-mounted bypass control for cutting the effect in or out. Specifications Power: 9V battery (accessible by removing the bottom plate with 4 screws) Connections: Input jack, Output jack Highlights Crown-branded version of the Super Fuzz circuit Same OEM design as other models of the era Produces octave-rich, snarling fuzz tones Compact and straightforward vintage design Collectible among enthusiasts of Japanese-made pedals Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet + Add your review Related Guyatone FS-3 Fuzz (related?)
